import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_5/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_5/test_1.csv"
    
    # Define target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_5/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    
    # Load Source 0: ComunaID, ComunaNombre, ProvinciaID
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Ensure correct dtypes (ProvinciaID and ComunaID as int, names as string)
    df_source0['ProvinciaID'] = df_source0['ProvinciaID'].astype(int)
    df_source0['ComunaID'] = df_source0['ComunaID'].astype(int)
    df_source0['ComunaNombre'] = df_source0['ComunaNombre'].astype(str)
    
    # Load Source 1: ProvinciaID, ProvinciaNombre, RegionID
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    df_source1['ProvinciaID'] = df_source1['ProvinciaID'].astype(int)
    df_source1['RegionID'] = df_source1['RegionID'].astype(int)
    df_source1['ProvinciaNombre'] = df_source1['ProvinciaNombre'].astype(str)
    
    # Join Source0 and Source1 on ProvinciaID to get full target schema
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='ProvinciaID', how='inner')
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['ProvinciaID', 'ProvinciaNombre', 'RegionID', 'ComunaID', 'ComunaNombre']
    df_target = df_merged[['ProvinciaID', 'ProvinciaNombre', 'RegionID', 'ComunaID', 'ComunaNombre']]
    
    # Save to CSV without index
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
